board.title: Your board
board.body: Tasks flow left → right through the columns. Drag a card to move it between statuses.

board-column-todo.title: Ready work
board-column-todo.body: The scheduler picks up the top of **To do** first — priority, then age. Blocked tasks wait here until their blockers finish.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this guide (or chat to your board, or ask the agent) from here whenever you like.

workflow-canvas.title: The canvas
workflow-canvas.body: Build an automation by wiring nodes here — a trigger, then the steps it fans out into.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: This tour lives in the assistant menu — reopen it from here whenever you need a refresher.

sessions-list.title: Live sessions
sessions-list.body: Every agent session shows here. Open one for its cockpit — transcript, terminal, and the task it is driving.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

memory-workspace.title: Knowledge base
memory-workspace.body: Gather sources, chat to your knowledge, and generate artifacts from a single workspace.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

dashboard.title: Your home base
dashboard.body: The dashboard rolls up your backlog, projects, and recent activity — a snapshot of the whole fleet at a glance.

dashboard-composer.title: Draft tasks fast
dashboard-composer.body: Type a feature list here — **one task per line** — then send it to the Backlog or To do when you're ready.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen any guide from here. Tip: press **⌘K** (Ctrl+K) anywhere to search and run commands from the keyboard.

office.title: The office floor
office.body: Watch your agents work in a live scene — walk up to a desk to call or message the agent working there.

office-view-toggle.title: 2D or 3D
office-view-toggle.body: Switch between the top-down **2D** floor and a first-person **3D** walkthrough. Your choice is remembered.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

projects.title: Your projects
projects.body: Group related work into projects — each gathers its tasks, a structured plan, and a knowledge base.

projects-new.title: Start one
projects-new.body: Spin up a project from scratch or from a template. From a goal, Midnite can even draft the whole task breakdown.

project-detail.title: The cockpit
project-detail.body: Open a project for its cockpit — **Details, Docs, Tasks, Roadmap**, all in one place.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

digests.title: Fleet digests
digests.body: The periodic roll-up of what your fleet **shipped, failed, and flagged** — generated by the Fable pipeline.

digests-content.title: Read the story
digests-content.body: Pick a digest to read its structured summary, with deep links back to the tasks behind each line.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: One full-text search across tasks, projects, memory, notes, councils, and workflows.

search-input.title: Try it
search-input.body: Type a query here to search across every type at once. **Click the box** to continue.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Tune how Midnite looks, locks, and runs your agents — appearance, safety, integrations, and more.

settings-nav.title: Browse categories
settings-nav.body: Jump between settings categories here. Appearance is where themes, density, and product-guide behaviour live.

assistant.title: Replay anytime
assistant.body: Reopen this tour from the assistant menu whenever you like.
